subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should local `chrome.launch: false` talkback preserve its prior unknown-microphone readiness behavior, or should the new explicit-unmuted policy intentionally apply to externally managed sessions too?
rationale: The merged extraction treated the old readiness semantics as a shipped compatibility contract, while this PR says externally managed mode is unchanged but its local bridge condition currently changes that behavior.

options.title: Preserve External Mode
options.body: Restrict explicit-unmuted gating to browser-managed joins and retain the existing local and paired-node `chrome.launch: false` contract.

options.title: Make All Modes Strict
options.body: Apply explicit-unmuted gating to externally managed sessions too, with an explicit compatibility decision, updated documentation, and live upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause Policy Change
options.body: Land only transcript retention and recovery ranking while deferring microphone readiness until live evidence establishes the safest contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve External Mode
recommendation.body: Restrict explicit-unmuted gating to browser-managed joins and retain the existing local and paired-node `chrome.launch: false` contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared runtime, documented the deferred policy question, and own the recent implementation history across both affected boundaries.
